extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent attorneys/agents, and USPTO examiners handling PCT matters
extracted.subtask_description: Chapter 1800 of the MPEP provides the USPTO's procedural and substantive guidance for handling international PCT applications, including filing requirements, search and examination practice, amendments, national stage entry, and related formalities. It is intended to guide preparation, filing, prosecution, and examination of PCT international applications and national-stage entries in the United States.
